note: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

rules.Subject: Absolute paths
rules.Rule: The working directory, the root of the fixture, the root of the reference, the root of the port, the home and the temporary directory become named placeholders; the longest prefix first; real paths are resolved first

rules.Subject: State layout
rules.Rule: Both sides map physical paths to logical names through the layout tables. It applies to captured trees and to the text of messages that name state

rules.Subject: Run id
rules.Rule: The as-is run id becomes a numbered placeholder, numbered by first appearance

rules.Subject: Timestamps
rules.Rule: Every time field, log header and file stamp of a transcript becomes a placeholder. Order is kept: values do not decrease where the reference's do not

rules.Subject: Durations
rules.Rule: Every duration becomes a placeholder, unless the fixture declares the value as the behaviour under test

rules.Subject: Nonce
rules.Rule: The 16 hexadecimal characters of each critic call become a numbered placeholder. First the comparator asserts the form and that no two calls share a nonce

rules.Subject: Process ids
rules.Rule: Process ids, process group ids and lock owners become numbered placeholders

rules.Subject: Temporary names
rules.Rule: Generated suffixes and names of temporary files become a placeholder

rules.Subject: Hash, same class
rules.Rule: Hashes over fixture content must be equal and are not normalized

rules.Subject: Hash, path class
rules.Rule: A hash whose input holds an absolute path is computed again from the side's own input, asserted, replaced by a placeholder, and the normalized inputs are compared

rules.Subject: Hash, implementation class
rules.Rule: A hash over bytes of the implementation: self-consistency is asserted, the value becomes a placeholder, the content is not compared

rules.Subject: Event vocabulary
rules.Rule: The compatibility projection of the port is compared, not its primary stream

rules.Subject: Event typing and duplicate keys
rules.Rule: Lines are read as ordered pairs of key and value with types kept, so that text against number and duplicate keys are compared as they are

rules.Subject: Event order
rules.Rule: Order is compared inside each class of writer. Interleaving between classes is not compared

rules.Subject: Implementation names in text
rules.Rule: A prefix that names an implementation file maps to a logical component name through the component-name table; the message after the prefix must be equal

rules.Subject: Generated-by fields
rules.Rule: Fields that name the generating tool compare through the component-name table

rules.Subject: Body of the launcher
rules.Rule: Compared as a logical record (marker present, hash valid, reference to the launch bundle resolves, arguments passed through), not as text

rules.Subject: Messages of the old interpreters
rules.Rule: Usage text and error text of the old language compare by exit code and by the class of the first line only

rules.Subject: Literals of the old language
rules.Rule: Compared as written. No rule hides them

rules.Subject: Output labels
rules.Rule: The supervisor lines and the digest are compared as written, in compatibility output

rules.Subject: Colour
rules.Rule: Captures run with colour off; a fixture that tests colour compares the escape sequences as written

rules.Subject: Objects of the repository
rules.Rule: Hashes of commits become numbered placeholders; message, tree content and the absence of a push are compared

rules.Subject: Counter files and transcripts of stub agents
rules.Rule: Counter files are left out of the tree; transcripts are compared after N-01 to N-08

rules.Subject: Prompt text
rules.Rule: Prompts are compared in full after N-01 to N-08

rules.Subject: Caches of the languages
rules.Rule: Left out; their presence inside the working directory is a failure

rules.Subject: Telemetry payloads
rules.Rule: Compared at the stub sink after N-03, N-04 and N-07

rules.Subject: Sorting that depends on the locale
rules.Rule: Both sides run with the same locale; the comparator does not sort for them

rules.Subject: Legacy state and names
rules.Rule: The behaviour of the legacy command names, legacy variables and the pre-v2 layout is not compared

rules.Subject: Field `schema` of a reverse-run source inventory
rules.Rule: The key `schema` is removed from the source inventory of a reverse run before the inventory is compared (DV-116: the as-is inventory carries `schema_version` 1 and no field `schema`)
